The number of 6 digit numbers that can be formed using the digits 0, 1, 2, 5, 7 and 9 which are divisible by
11 and no digit is repeated is :
en.explanation:
digit 0, 1, 2, 5, 7, 9



so (1, 2, 9) (0, 5, 7)

Now number of ways to arranging them

= 3! × 3! + 3! × 2 �� 2

= 6 × 6 + 6 × 4

= 6 × 10

= 60
